# A Toast to [Name] and [Partner]

Good evening, everyone! For those who don't know me, I'm [Your Name], and I've had the honor of being [Name]'s best friend for [number] years.

Most love stories begin with a meet-cute. Theirs began with a meet-soggy.

Three summers ago, a group of us went camping. I planned the trip, so let's be clear about who to blame. The forecast said "light showers." What we got was a weather event that I'm fairly certain had a name. Within an hour, our tents had become water features, the campfire refused to cooperate, and the trail mix had somehow turned into soup.

Everyone was miserable. Well, *almost* everyone. While the rest of us huddled in the car arguing about whose idea this was (again, mine), [Name] and [Partner] were sitting under one leaky tarp, laughing like it was the best night of their lives.

I remember thinking, "Those two are either in shock, or something is happening here."

Turns out, it was both.

Here's what I learned that weekend: anyone can be happy when the sun is shining. But finding someone who makes you laugh when everything is falling apart, when you're cold, wet, and eating trail mix soup, is rare. That's the real thing.

[Name], [Partner], you found shelter in each other on the worst night imaginable. I hope every storm ahead feels just as small when you face it together.

So please, raise your glasses. To [Name] and [Partner]: may your love always outlast the forecast.

Cheers!
